title: Fix a debounce that throttles, keeps stale arguments, and skips validation
fail_to_pass: resets the pending timer when called again inside the wait window
pushes the deadline further on every call in a burst
invokes the callback with the arguments from the most recent call
throws a RangeError when waitMs is negative
pass_to_pass: does not invoke the callback before the wait elapses
invokes the callback once for a single call
invokes the callback only once for a burst of calls
starts a fresh wait window after invoking
